description: This is a Java test source file for the User class, containing unit tests that verify role management and superuser status in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: UserTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the User class's role management and superuser features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a User object and assigns a role before each test.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldHaveRole
methods.description: Verifies that the user properly recognizes a role it has.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldNotHaveRole
methods.description: Verifies that the user does not recognize a role it does not have.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldHaveAnyRoleWhenSuperUser
methods.description: Checks that user with superuser role has all roles.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldNotHaveAnyRoleWhenSuperWhenIgnoreSuperUserFlagIsTrue
methods.description: Ensures that ignoring superuser privileges results in no role recognition.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldBeSuperUser
methods.description: Checks that adding superuser role sets superuser status.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldNotBeSuperUser
methods.description: Verifies that user without superuser role is not recognized as superuser.

methods.name: containsRole_shouldBeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Tests that role checks are case-insensitive.

methods.name: containsRole_shouldReturnTrueIfTheUserHasTheGivenRole
methods.description: Confirms that containRole recognizes an existing role.

methods.name: containsRole_shouldReturnFalseIfTheUserDoesNotHaveTheGivenRole
methods.description: Checks that containRole returns false for nonexistent roles.
